families.label: epsilon8-utility-boundary

privacy.accountant: the same conservative Gaussian RDP accountant as the frozen main study

success_criterion.integrity: all four methods complete without NaN and every claimed certificate validates
success_criterion.absolute_utility: mean UnitScope FEMNIST writer macro accuracy is at least 0.20 and mean UnitScope Synthea patient AUPRC is at least 0.28
success_criterion.comparative: no direction is required and every paired result is reported

families.reporting: epsilon=8 utility-boundary table; the epsilon=4 main table remains unchanged

partition.construction: Dirichlet class-conditional silo assignment for overlapping writers; stable silo for other writers; no record duplication

success_criterion.integrity: all four methods complete without NaN and UnitScope remains C-certified
success_criterion.robustness: the mean UnitScope drop from alpha 0.5 to alpha 0.1 is no more than 0.05 absolute writer macro accuracy
success_criterion.comparative: UnitScope is not required to rank first and an unfavorable result is reported as a regime boundary

families.label: account-level-text-task
families.model: 512-dimensional stateless signed hashing features and a 512-64-2 MLP
families.task: binary tweet sentiment with account-disjoint splits and account macro accuracy
families.population: 2,000 accounts with at least two records, capped at 32 records per account by a stable public hash
families.topology: six silos, 0.5 account-overlap probability, no record duplication, stable public assignment

success_criterion.integrity: all methods complete without NaN, all account splits are disjoint, and every user-level method validates its declared sensitivity
success_criterion.external_validity: UnitScope produces a valid C-certified full-retention plan on both additional modalities
success_criterion.comparative: no winning direction is required and all paired outcomes are reported
